text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 2-pixel solid focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity. This gives keyboard users a clear, visible target without overwhelming the interface, balancing visibility with subtlety. The glow ensures visibility on all backgrounds, including light and dark themes, while the solid ring provides a crisp outline for precision. Trade-off: the glow may slightly reduce contrast in high-contrast modes, but the solid ring remains visible.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring + 2px glow bleeds at 125% zoom—it’s not just "slightly less prominent," it’s a fuzzy mess that obscures adjacent elements. A 1px ring + 1px glow risks disappearing on low-contrast backgrounds, but that’s fixable with a 3:1 contrast ratio for the ring itself. Settle it with a live test: measure both at 125% zoom and 3:1 contrast against a white and black background—if the 1px version fails, bump the ring to 2px but cap the glow at 1px.
